# Bouncer

Bouncer is an email verification and validation service that helps ensure email deliverability by verifying email addresses through real-time and batch processing APIs.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/bouncer/.

## Actions

- **Create Batch Request**: Initiate a batch email verification request.
- **Create Toxicity List Job**: Create a toxicity analysis job for a list of email addresses.
- **Finish Batch**: Mark a batch verification process as finished.
- **Verify Domain**: Verify the validity and configuration of a domain.
- **Verify Email**: Verify a single email address in real-time.
- **Check Toxicity List Job Status** (read-only): Check the status of a specific toxicity list job.
- **Delete batch request**: Delete a batch verification request.
- **Delete Toxicity List Job**: Delete a specific toxicity list job.
- **Get Batch Results** (read-only): Retrieve the results of a batch verification process.
